Ceahlău Massif

Ceahlău Massif. External links: www.peisaje-montane.ro Pictures and images from the Carpathian Mountains

Caption: The Ceahlău Massif's rugged, limestone peaks rise dramatically under an overcast sky, framed by dense coniferous forests. The imposing, jagged summits of this Romanian mountain range stand against a cloudy backdrop, showcasing its characteristic alpine terrain and wild, untamed character.
